headline: Williams' double in the 15th beats Marlins after rally
recap: The Phillies trailed by five runs after six innings before rallying to beat the Miami Marlins 9-8 in 15 innings. A replay reversal helped tie the game in the ninth, and Rhys Hoskins' second home run of the night tied it again in the 10th. The game stayed scoreless from there until the bottom of the 15th, when Aaron Altherr singled and, with two outs, Nick Williams doubled him home off Javy Guerra for the winning run.

Nick Pivetta started for Philadelphia and allowed seven runs over five innings; Dillon Peters started for Miami and allowed two runs over six. Eight Phillies relievers followed Pivetta, with Edubray Ramos working the 14th and 15th innings for the win.

Hoskins supplied most of the power, homering in the seventh to trim Miami's lead and again in the bottom of the 10th to answer a go-ahead home run from Marcell Ozuna, his 15th and 16th of the season. Philadelphia had also scored three straight RBI hits from Jorge Alfaro, J.P. Crawford and Freddy Galvis in the eighth to cut the deficit to one run before tying it in the ninth.
